snippet.title: Six Flags Fun Park [40] Wii Longplay
snippet.description:
Six Flags Fun Park is a 2009 adventure game that originated as an original IP called Fun Park before Brash Entertainment decided they needed a license to help boost sells so in the final months of devolvement they reached a license deal with Flags since it required the least amount of change to the game itself. One of the few changes Six Flags requested was to remove the fire from the firefighters game since Six Flags had a corporate aversion to fire. In the game, a boy and his Dad built a theme park together. They no longer saw eye to eye. The boy wanted to built more progressive rides while the father wanted to continue maintaining the old school rides. This lead to a fallout and the boy took over the park and closed all the old school rides. You help the father rebuild all the old rides an reunite the son and the father by showing them both its ok to mix old school and newer rides in the same theme park. There are a few areas in the park: Hometown Square, Fright Fest, Astro City, Hurricane Harbor, and Funville.

Compilation of this game's cutscenes: https://youtu.be/hAFUE14GQAM
More Wii longplays: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLBA7nqyBa-vzHGiZjQv40P3UnyJlVzkzq

This longplay was requested by: Coralhorse10 /a lenstar production company
